_status: Module 3, Lesson 3.2 'Data moving (in transit)' and 'Data stored (at rest)' (learner guide of 21 October 2026). Each item's reason is the guide's protection for it. Fictional office.
prompt: Is the data **moving** or **stored**? Then name its protection.

categories.label: Moving
categories.hint: HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or 1.3 (1.0 and 1.1 deprecated in 2021), VPN, SFTP, WPA3, secure links

categories.label: Stored
categories.hint: Full-disk, database and file encryption; encrypted USB; encrypted backups

items.text: A citizen submits an application on the portal
Ana sends files to a partner agency
items.why: SFTP or HTTPS, never plain FTP

items.text: A USB drive with home-visit forms

items.why: WPA3, or WPA2-Enterprise with personal logins

items.text: An email with a medical certificate attached
Sol opens office systems from home
